text_a: Marta dijo que el informe ya estaba enviado.
text_b: Según Marta, el informe ya se había enviado.

text_a: The manager said the budget was approved.
text_b: The manager claims the budget was approved.
what_differs: 'said' reports neutrally; 'claims' signals doubt about truth of the statement

text_a: O Carlos disse que o cliente cancelou o pedido.
text_b: De acordo com o Carlos, o cliente cancelou o pedido.

text_a: El técnico dijo que el servidor probablemente fallaría.
text_b: El técnico dijo que el servidor fallaría.
what_differs: 'probablemente' removes certainty from the reported prediction

text_a: If we had shipped on Monday, the client would have been happy.
text_b: Had we shipped on Monday, the client would have been happy.

text_a: Si llueve mañana, cancelaremos el evento.
text_b: Si hubiera llovido ayer, habríamos cancelado el evento.
what_differs: future real condition vs past counterfactual

text_a: Se eu tivesse recebido o e-mail, teria respondido.
text_b: Eu não recebi o e-mail, por isso não respondi.

text_a: If the test passes, we will deploy.
text_b: Once the test passes, we will deploy.
what_differs: 'if' leaves open whether it passes; 'once' presupposes it will; readers may differ

text_a: Cerré la ventana para que no entrara ruido.
text_b: Cerré la ventana a fin de evitar que entrara ruido.

text_a: He rewrote the script so that it would run faster.
text_b: He rewrote the script, with the result that it ran faster.
what_differs: intended purpose vs actual outcome; the second asserts success

text_a: Ela guardou o contrato em cofre para evitar perdê-lo.
text_b: Ela guardou o contrato em cofre a fim de não o perder.

text_a: Subieron los precios para mejorar el margen.
text_b: Subieron los precios, así que el margen mejoró.
what_differs: purpose reading vs consequence reading; informal speakers may treat as same

text_a: Leave the keys on the desk.
text_b: Leave the keys inside the desk.
what_differs: on top of vs inside

text_a: El archivo está en la carpeta de Ventas.
text_b: El archivo está dentro de la carpeta de Ventas.

text_a: Estacione o carro ao lado do prédio.
text_b: Estacione o carro atrás do prédio.
what_differs: beside vs behind

text_a: The printer is next to the kitchen.
text_b: The printer is near the kitchen.
what_differs: 'next to' implies adjacency; 'near' is looser; may or may not be treated as same

text_a: Ana le dijo a Lucía que su jefe la llamaría.
text_b: Ana le dijo a Lucía que el jefe de Ana llamaría a Lucía.
what_differs: 'su' and 'la' are ambiguous; the second resolves one reading

text_a: The report and the summary were reviewed; the former was approved.
text_b: The report and the summary were reviewed; the report was approved.

text_a: O gerente e o analista chegaram; o primeiro assinou o contrato.
text_b: O gerente e o analista chegaram; o último assinou o contrato.
what_differs: first (manager) vs last (analyst) signed

text_a: Tom told Sam that he had won the prize.
text_b: Tom told Sam that Sam had won the prize.
what_differs: original 'he' may refer to Tom; second fixes it to Sam

text_a: Termina el análisis en menos de dos horas.
text_b: Termina el análisis dentro de las próximas dos horas.

text_a: The store will be closed until Friday.
text_b: The store will be closed by Friday.
what_differs: closed through Friday vs closing at some point before Friday

text_a: Trabalhe nisto durante duas horas.
text_b: Termine isto em até duas horas.
what_differs: work for a fixed duration vs finish before a time limit

text_a: Submit the form until Friday.
text_b: Submit the form by Friday.
what_differs: 'until' is non-standard with a punctual verb; most read it as a deadline but not certain

text_a: Por favor, envía la factura hoy.
text_b: ¿Podrías enviar la factura hoy?

text_a: You must approve the invoice.
text_b: You may approve the invoice.
what_differs: obligation vs permission

text_a: Fique à vontade para usar a sala de reuniões.
text_b: Você pode usar a sala de reuniões.

text_a: Could you update the spreadsheet?
text_b: Update the spreadsheet.
what_differs: polite request vs direct command; same action but register/obligation may differ

text_a: Borra los archivos y carpetas antiguos.
text_b: Borra las carpetas y los archivos que sean antiguos.

text_a: Review the first two tasks.
text_b: Review the first task and the second task.

text_a: Venda os carros vermelhos ou azuis novos.
text_b: Venda os carros vermelhos novos ou os azuis de qualquer idade.
what_differs: 'novos' scopes over both colors vs only red

text_a: Delete the old files and folders.
text_b: Delete the old files and all folders.
what_differs: first is ambiguous: 'old' may modify only files or both; second resolves one reading

text_a: Fue Pedro quien reservó la sala.
text_b: Quien reservó la sala fue Pedro.

text_a: We need to fix the login page, not the signup page.
text_b: We need to fix the login page and the signup page.
what_differs: exclusion of signup vs inclusion

text_a: Quero chá em vez de café.
text_b: Prefiro chá a café.
what_differs: current choice vs general preference; may or may not be read as same

text_a: It is the deadline that worries me, not the budget.
text_b: The deadline worries me rather than the budget.

text_a: Julia ya terminó la presentación.
text_b: Julia está terminando la presentación.
what_differs: completed vs still in progress

text_a: The team has finished the migration.
text_b: The migration has been completed by the team.

text_a: Quando você chegar, eu já terei terminado o relatório.
text_b: Eu vou terminar o relatório antes de você chegar.

text_a: She started the backup at noon.
text_b: She has started the backup.
what_differs: specific past time vs present relevance; whether it is finished or the time matters is open
